models.name: text2image
models.description: Pixray is a text-to-image system that uses CLIP to guide image creation. It captures an approach that preceded the widespread adoption of Stable Diffusion.
models.notes: CLIP-guided pixray, the pre-diffusion aesthetic

models.name: disco-diffusion
models.description: Disco Diffusion combines diffusion-based image generation with CLIP guidance. It captures the text-to-image approach popular just before Stable Diffusion became widely available.
models.notes: CLIP-guided diffusion, the aesthetic immediately before Stable Diffusion

models.name: glid-3-xl
models.description: GLID-3 XL is an early latent-diffusion image model using CLIP text embeddings, placing it among the archive's models from around the original crungus discovery.
models.notes: GLID-3 XL, early latent diffusion

models.name: dalle-mini
models.description: DALL-E mini is the model behind the original crungus discovery in June 2022. This listing preserves a version from that month for comparison.
models.notes: the original DALL-E mini, pinned at a 2022-06-14 version — the model and month of the crungus discovery. Returns [{image, clip_score}], hence output_field

models.name: min-dalle
models.description: Min-DALLE is a compact PyTorch implementation of DALL-E mini, the model family behind the original crungus discovery. It anchors the archive's early comparisons.
models.notes: PyTorch port of DALL-E mini, the model behind Craiyon and the original June 2022 crungus discovery

models.name: stable-diffusion
models.description: Stable Diffusion is Stability AI's early latent-diffusion image model, released shortly after the original crungus discovery. This listing represents the first-generation model family.
models.notes: Stable Diffusion (1.x line as pinned on Replicate)

models.name: waifu-diffusion
models.description: Waifu Diffusion is a Stable Diffusion fine-tune trained on Danbooru imagery, specialising in anime illustration. It extends the archive's early style-specific models.
models.notes: Stable Diffusion fine-tuned on Danbooru; the first big style-shifted fork

models.name: stable-diffusion-v1-5
models.description: Stable Diffusion 1.5 is a revision of the first-generation Stable Diffusion model, subsequently used as the base for many community fine-tunes.
models.notes: Stable Diffusion 1.5 itself, the most-forked open image model of the era

models.name: openjourney
models.description: Openjourney is a Stable Diffusion fine-tune trained on Midjourney V4 images, bringing that model's visual style into the archive through an independently hosted model.
models.notes: Midjourney-style SD 1.5 fine-tune, peak 2022 aesthetic

models.name: midjourney-diffusion
models.description: Midjourney Diffusion is a Stable Diffusion fine-tune aimed at the Midjourney V4 look. It is a community derivative, rather than Midjourney's own model.
models.notes: SD fine-tuned towards the Midjourney v4 look, when Midjourney itself had no API

models.name: material-diffusion
models.description: Material Diffusion is a Stable Diffusion 1.5 derivative trained to generate tileable textures. It interprets crungus through a model intended for repeating surface patterns.

models.name: stable-diffusion-v2
models.description: Stable Diffusion 2 is Stability AI's second-generation diffusion model. This community implementation provides a comparison with the first-generation Stable Diffusion models in the archive.
models.notes: Stable Diffusion 2.x

models.name: anything-v3.0
models.description: Anything V3 is a Stable Diffusion fine-tune specialising in anime imagery. It provides an early example of a model trained around a particular visual style.
models.notes: anime SD fine-tune era artifact

models.name: riffusion
models.description: Riffusion adapts Stable Diffusion to generate spectrograms that are converted into music. Released in 2022, it is an early counterpart to the image archive.
models.notes: Stable Diffusion fine-tuned on spectrograms — the crungus's contemporary in sound; clips are ~5 s

models.name: kandinsky-2
models.description: Kandinsky 2 is an early model in AI Forever's text-to-image family, trained on high-resolution image data and further fine-tuned on internal datasets.
models.notes: Kandinsky 2.1, the non-SD lineage

models.name: bark
models.description: Bark is Suno's text-prompted audio model, capable of speech and other sounds as well as music. A bare word can become spoken audio.
models.notes: text-prompted generative audio, not strictly music: given a bare word it mostly speaks it

models.name: deepfloyd-if
models.description: DeepFloyd IF is a text-to-image diffusion model that builds images in stages, starting in pixel space. It offers a different approach from latent-diffusion models.
models.notes: DeepFloyd IF, pixel-space diffusion

models.name: musicgen-looper
models.description: MusicGen Looper adapts MusicGen to generate musical loops at a fixed tempo. It brings a repeating musical form to the archive's audio comparisons.

models.name: kandinsky-2.2
models.description: Kandinsky 2.2 is AI Forever's multilingual text-to-image diffusion model. It is also the decoder this project uses to render its semantic eigencrungi.

models.name: sdxl
models.description: Stable Diffusion XL, or SDXL, is Stability AI's general-purpose image model. Many of the archive's photographic and illustration-focused fine-tunes are derived from it.
models.notes: SDXL (in collection historically; keep pinned here regardless)

models.name: realistic-vision-v5.1
models.description: Realistic Vision 5.1 is a Stable Diffusion fine-tune designed for photographic imagery. It provides a specialised comparison with the general-purpose models in the archive.

models.name: sdxl-emoji
models.description: SDXL Emoji is a Stable Diffusion XL fine-tune based on Apple emoji imagery, giving the archive a model trained for a specific illustration style.

models.name: musicgen-chord
models.description: MusicGen Chord adapts MusicGen to condition music on a chord sequence and tempo, adding harmonic controls to the underlying text-to-music model.

models.name: ssd-1b
models.description: SSD-1B is Segmind's compressed version of Stable Diffusion XL, designed to reduce model size and generation time while retaining general text-to-image capabilities.

models.name: playground-v2-1024px-aesthetic
models.description: Playground 2 is a text-to-image diffusion model trained from scratch by Playground. It precedes the aesthetics-focused Playground 2.5 model also included here.
models.notes: Playground v2, the generation before the v2.5 already in the archive

models.name: dreamshaper-xl-turbo
models.description: DreamShaper XL Turbo is an accelerated SDXL-based model intended for both photographic and illustrated imagery, including anime, rather than a single specialist style.

models.name: sdxl-multi-controlnet-lora
models.description: This implementation of Stable Diffusion XL supports reference-image controls and LoRA fine-tunes. The archive uses it as a text-to-image model without reference inputs.

models.name: open-dalle-v1.1
models.description: OpenDalle 1.1 is an SDXL-based image model developed for prompt following and varied visual styles. It is a community model independent of OpenAI's DALL-E.

models.name: realvisxl-v3-multi-controlnet-lora
models.description: RealVisXL 3 is a photographic fine-tune of Stable Diffusion XL. This implementation adds reference-image controls and LoRA support; the archive uses text-only generation.

models.name: latent-consistency-model
models.description: This Latent Consistency Model implementation accelerates text-to-image generation. It also supports image-based guidance, although the archive supplies only the crungus text prompts.

models.name: magnet
models.description: MAGNeT is Meta's text-to-audio model, generating audio through a masked, non-autoregressive transformer. It provides an alternative to MusicGen's sequential generation approach.

models.name: realvisxl-v3.0-turbo
models.description: RealVisXL 3 Turbo is an accelerated photographic fine-tune of Stable Diffusion XL, combining the RealVisXL family's realism focus with faster image generation.

models.name: proteus-v0.2
models.description: Proteus 0.2 is a community image model derived from OpenDalle, developed for prompt following and a range of photographic and illustrated styles.

models.name: proteus-v0.3
models.description: Proteus 0.3 is a fine-tuned image model derived from OpenDalle, with additional anime training. It also retains photographic and other illustration styles.

models.name: playground-v2.5-1024px-aesthetic
models.description: Playground 2.5 is Playground's image-generation model with an emphasis on visual aesthetics. It follows Playground 2, which is also represented in the archive.

models.name: musicgen
models.description: MusicGen is Meta's music-generation model, capable of working from text descriptions or a guiding melody. The archive uses only the crungus text prompts.

models.name: sticker-maker
models.description: Sticker Maker combines an SDXL-based image model with a sticker fine-tune and transparency support, designed to turn text prompts into isolated sticker graphics.

models.name: stable-diffusion-3
models.description: Stable Diffusion 3 is Stability AI's third-generation image model, developed with an emphasis on typography and complex prompts. The archive also includes the later 3.5 family.
models.notes: SD3, the generation before the 3.5 line already in the archive

models.name: flux-music
models.description: FluxMusic is a text-to-music model built around a rectified-flow transformer. It shares a name with the FLUX image family but generates audio.

models.name: flux-1.1-pro
models.description: FLUX 1.1 Pro is a revision of Black Forest Labs' FLUX Pro image model, developed to improve generation speed and prompt following.
models.notes: base FLUX 1.1 Pro; the archive had only the -ultra variant

models.name: photon
models.description: Photon is Luma's image-generation model, designed for photographic detail and creative work. Photon Flash provides a faster variant of the same family.

models.name: sana
models.description: SANA is NVIDIA's image-generation model, designed for efficient generation at high resolutions across artistic styles. SANA-Sprint provides a further accelerated member of the family.

models.name: sdxl-lightning-4step
models.description: SDXL-Lightning is ByteDance's accelerated version of Stable Diffusion XL. This variant generates images in four steps, using distillation to shorten the diffusion process.

models.name: gpt-image-1
models.description: GPT Image 1 is OpenAI's first GPT Image model, supporting image generation and editing. It begins the archive's sequence of GPT Image versions.
models.notes: the first GPT Image; the archive had only 1.5 and 2. A passthrough listing: it wants the caller's own OpenAI key, so this bills to OpenAI rather than Replicate

models.name: ace-step
models.description: ACE-Step is a music-generation model that accepts style tags and lyrics. Here the crungus prompts provide the tags used to generate the clips.

models.name: sdxl-lightning
models.description: Pruna AI's implementation of SDXL-Lightning accelerates image generation from text. It belongs to the family of distilled models derived from Stable Diffusion XL.

models.name: flux-schnell-lora
models.description: This version of Black Forest Labs' FLUX Schnell supports LoRA fine-tunes, combining the speed-focused base model with adapters for specific subjects or styles.

models.name: flux-dev
models.description: FLUX Dev is Black Forest Labs' 12-billion-parameter image model with downloadable weights. It is one of the base models behind the wider FLUX family.

models.name: flux-dev-lora
models.description: This version of Black Forest Labs' FLUX Dev supports LoRA adapters, small fine-tunes that specialise an image model for particular subjects or styles.

models.name: flux-schnell
models.description: FLUX Schnell is Black Forest Labs' speed-focused image model with downloadable weights, designed for generation in a few steps. Its name is German for fast.

models.name: hidream-l1-dev
models.description: HiDream-I1 Dev is an accelerated version of the HiDream image model, served through Pruna AI's optimised implementation. It sits between Full and Fast.

models.name: hidream-l1-full
models.description: HiDream-I1 Full is the full version of the HiDream image model, served here through Pruna AI's optimised implementation. Dev and Fast provide accelerated variants.

models.name: wan-2.2-image
models.description: Wan 2.2 Image is Pruna AI's image-generation model derived from the Wan 2.2 family, using its optimisation toolkit to shorten generation time.

models.name: sana-sprint-1.6b
models.description: SANA-Sprint is NVIDIA's accelerated image model, using a distilled version of SANA to generate an image in a single diffusion step.

models.name: flux-krea-dev
models.description: FLUX Krea Dev is Black Forest Labs' collaboration with Krea, retraining FLUX Dev for photographic imagery with a more natural, less saturated appearance.
models.notes: FLUX dev retrained with Krea for a deliberately un-AI aesthetic

models.name: gemini-2.5-flash-image
models.description: Gemini 2.5 Flash Image is Google's image-generation and editing model, also known as Nano Banana. The archive includes both Replicate listings.
models.notes: the Gemini image model that became nano-banana

models.name: hunyuan-image-3
models.description: HunyuanImage 3 is Tencent's multimodal image-generation model. This Replicate listing uses Pruna AI optimisations, and the archive supplies text prompts without reference images.

models.name: music
models.description: Eleven Music is ElevenLabs' music-generation model, accepting text prompts or structured composition plans. The archive gives it the same short crungus prompts as other audio models.

models.name: ideogram-v2
models.description: Ideogram 2 is Ideogram's second-generation image model, developed with an emphasis on prompt interpretation and text rendering. Turbo provides its accelerated variant.

models.name: ideogram-v2-turbo
models.description: Ideogram 2 Turbo is the speed-focused variant of Ideogram's second-generation image model, with support for text rendering and editing selected regions of an image.

models.name: ideogram-v2a
models.description: Ideogram 2a is a revision of Ideogram's second-generation image model, designed to reduce generation time and cost while retaining its text-rendering capabilities.

models.name: ideogram-v2a-turbo
models.description: Ideogram 2a Turbo is the accelerated version of Ideogram 2a, part of a family designed for image generation and text within images.

models.name: ideogram-v3-balanced
models.description: Ideogram 3 Balanced is the middle variant of Ideogram's third-generation image model, balancing generation speed and cost with image quality and text rendering.

models.name: ideogram-v3-quality
models.description: Ideogram 3 Quality is the quality-focused variant of Ideogram's third-generation image model, designed for realistic imagery and graphic design with integrated text.

models.name: ideogram-v3-turbo
models.description: Ideogram 3 Turbo is the fastest variant of Ideogram's third-generation image model, designed for lower-cost generation with the family's image and text-rendering capabilities.

models.name: photon-flash
models.description: Photon Flash is the accelerated variant of Luma's Photon image model, designed to shorten generation time while retaining the family's visual capabilities.

models.name: image-01
models.description: Image-01 is MiniMax's first image-generation model. It also supports character references, although the images here are generated from text alone.

models.name: music-1.5
models.description: Music 1.5 is MiniMax's song-generation model, supporting vocals and instrumental accompaniment. In this archive, its supplied lyrics consist of crungus repeated three times.
models.notes: requires a 10–300 character prompt, so the bare word is rejected upstream; lyrics are the word three times

models.name: recraft-v3
models.description: Recraft V3 is a design-focused image model, also known as Red Panda, developed for graphic styles and text within images. Its SVG variant generates vectors.

models.name: recraft-v3-svg
models.description: Recraft V3 SVG generates vector illustrations, including icons and logos, from text prompts. The archive displays rasterised versions alongside images from other models.

models.name: stable-audio-2.5
models.description: Stable Audio 2.5 is Stability AI's text-to-audio model, designed for music and sound generation. It interprets the crungus prompts as descriptions of audio.

models.name: stable-diffusion-3.5-large
models.description: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large is Stability AI's larger general-purpose model in the 3.5 family, supporting image generation across photographic and artistic styles.

models.name: stable-diffusion-3.5-large-turbo
models.description: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large Turbo is a distilled version of Stability AI's Large model, designed to generate images with fewer inference steps.

models.name: stable-diffusion-3.5-medium
models.description: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium is the smaller, 2.5-billion-parameter model in Stability AI's 3.5 family, offering general-purpose image generation with lower hardware requirements.

models.name: flux-fast
models.description: FLUX Fast is Pruna AI's accelerated implementation of a FLUX image model, intended to reduce generation time. The archive tests it with the same prompts.

models.name: flux-pro
models.description: FLUX Pro is Black Forest Labs' original commercial FLUX image model, designed for detailed imagery and prompt following. Later FLUX generations also appear here.

models.name: flux-kontext-max
models.description: FLUX Kontext Max is the quality-focused variant of Black Forest Labs' Kontext image model, with an emphasis on instruction following and text rendering.

models.name: flux-kontext-pro
models.description: FLUX Kontext Pro is Black Forest Labs' image-generation and editing model, designed to follow written instructions while preserving subjects across edits.

models.name: rd-fast
models.description: RD Fast is Retro Diffusion's speed-focused pixel-art model. It gives the archive a specialist generator designed around small images and deliberately visible pixels.
models.notes: pixel art model; 256×256 by default

models.name: rd-plus
models.description: RD Plus is Retro Diffusion's quality-focused pixel-art model, complementing RD Fast. Its intended medium brings a different visual constraint to the crungus prompts.
models.notes: pixel art model; 256×256 by default

models.name: seedream-4
models.description: Seedream 4 is ByteDance's image-generation and editing model, supporting high-resolution output. This archive records its responses to the same short text prompts as other models.

models.name: flux-2-dev
models.description: FLUX.2 Dev is the open-weight version of Black Forest Labs' FLUX.2 image-generation and editing model, supporting reference images as well as text prompts.
models.notes: the open-weight FLUX.2; the archive had flex, klein, max and pro

models.name: lyria-2
models.description: Lyria 2 is Google's text-to-music model, generating stereo instrumental audio. Its clips provide a musical interpretation of the same word used by the image models.

models.name: flux-2-klein-4b
models.description: FLUX.2 Klein 4B is a compact, distilled image-generation and editing model from Black Forest Labs, designed to produce images in a few steps.

models.name: qwen-image
models.description: Qwen-Image is an image-generation model from Alibaba's Qwen team, developed with an emphasis on rendering complex text within generated images.

models.name: gpt-image-1.5
models.description: GPT Image 1.5 is a revision of OpenAI's GPT Image model, developed to improve instruction following and adherence to image-generation prompts.

models.name: fibo
models.description: FIBO is BRIA's open image-generation model trained on licensed data. It uses structured descriptions to give finer control over the content of an image.

models.name: image-3.2
models.description: BRIA Image 3.2 is a text-to-image model trained on licensed data, designed for commercial imagery with an emphasis on aesthetics and text rendering.

models.name: nano-banana
models.description: Nano Banana is Google's Gemini 2.5 image model, capable of generating images and editing them through written instructions. Here it receives text prompts alone.

models.name: grok-imagine-image
models.description: Grok Imagine Image is xAI's image-generation model. The archive also includes its Quality variant and later Image 2 model for comparison.

models.name: recraft-v4
models.description: Recraft V4 is Recraft's fourth-generation image model, designed for graphic composition and integrated text rendering. Pro provides a higher-resolution variant of the same family.
models.notes: plain recraft v4; the archive had the pro and SVG variants only

models.name: recraft-v4-pro
models.description: Recraft V4 Pro is the higher-resolution variant of Recraft's fourth-generation image model, designed for graphic composition and text within images, including print work.

models.name: recraft-v4-pro-svg
models.description: Recraft V4 Pro SVG generates vector graphics with finer geometric detail than the standard variant. Its outputs are rasterised for display in this archive.

models.name: recraft-v4-svg
models.description: Recraft V4 SVG generates vector graphics as editable shapes and paths. The archive displays rasterised versions so they can be compared with other images.

models.name: seedream-5-lite
models.description: Seedream 5 Lite is ByteDance's image-generation and editing model with built-in reasoning. It supports reference-based edits, while this archive uses text-only generation.

models.name: qwen-image-2
models.description: Qwen-Image 2 is Alibaba's image-generation and editing model, developed with an emphasis on text rendering, particularly Chinese text within generated images.

models.name: flux-2-max
models.description: FLUX.2 Max is the quality-focused variant of Black Forest Labs' FLUX.2 image family, positioned above Pro for image fidelity.

models.name: flux-2-pro
models.description: FLUX.2 Pro is Black Forest Labs' image-generation and editing model, supporting multiple reference images. The archive tests its generation from text alone.

models.name: wan-2.7-image
models.description: Wan 2.7 Image is an image-generation and editing model from Alibaba's Wan family. Its text-only outputs appear here alongside the Pro variant.

models.name: wan-2.7-image-pro
models.description: Wan 2.7 Image Pro is the higher-resolution variant of Alibaba's Wan image model, supporting image generation and editing with a reasoning mode.

models.name: hidream-l1-fast
models.description: HiDream-I1 Fast is the speed-focused version of the HiDream image model. This listing uses Pruna AI's optimisation toolkit to accelerate generation.

models.name: music-2.5
models.description: Music 2.5 is MiniMax's song-generation model with vocals and instrumental accompaniment. The archive supplies the word crungus three times as its lyrics.
models.notes: lyrics are the word three times

models.name: music-2.6
models.description: Music 2.6 is MiniMax's model for songs and instrumentals, supporting supplied or automatically generated lyrics. This archive supplies crungus repeated three times.
models.notes: lyrics are the word three times

models.name: flux-1.1-pro-ultra
models.description: FLUX 1.1 Pro Ultra is Black Forest Labs' higher-resolution variant of FLUX 1.1 Pro. It also offers a Raw mode intended for natural-looking photography.

models.name: flux-2-flex
models.description: FLUX.2 Flex is a variant of Black Forest Labs' image-generation and editing family, supporting reference images and adjustable generation controls.

models.name: grok-imagine-image-quality
models.description: Grok Imagine Image Quality is xAI's quality-focused image model, developed for finer detail and text rendering. It complements the standard Grok Imagine Image listing.
models.notes: the higher-quality tier of xAI's image model

models.name: recraft-v4.1
models.description: Recraft V4.1 is a revision of Recraft's design-focused image model, developed for composition and integrated text rendering. Pro and Utility provide related variants.

models.name: recraft-v4.1-pro
models.description: Recraft V4.1 Pro is the higher-resolution variant of Recraft's V4.1 image model, designed for graphic composition and text rendering in larger images.

models.name: recraft-v4.1-utility
models.description: Recraft V4.1 Utility is the lighter, faster variant of Recraft's design-focused image model, intended for high-volume generation with the same composition and typography focus.

models.name: recraft-v4.1-utility-pro
models.description: Recraft V4.1 Utility Pro combines the Utility variant's faster generation with higher-resolution output, retaining the Recraft family's focus on graphic composition and typography.

models.name: seedream-4.5
models.description: Seedream 4.5 is a revision of ByteDance's image-generation and editing model, developed with an emphasis on spatial relationships and knowledge of real-world subjects.

models.name: ideogram-v4-balanced
models.description: Ideogram 4 Balanced is the middle variant of Ideogram's fourth-generation image model, designed to balance generation speed and cost with visual quality.

models.name: ideogram-v4-quality
models.description: Ideogram 4 Quality is the quality-focused variant of Ideogram's fourth-generation image model, complementing Balanced with a greater emphasis on the finished image.

models.name: lyria-3
models.description: Lyria 3 is Google's music-generation model, producing fixed 30-second clips from text or image prompts. The archive uses its text-prompted generation.
models.notes: fixed 30 s clips

models.name: lyria-3-pro
models.description: Lyria 3 Pro is Google's model for longer-form music generation, supporting songs up to three minutes. These examples use the archive's short text prompts.
models.notes: full-length songs, up to 3 minutes; no duration input

models.name: nano-banana-2-lite
models.description: Nano Banana 2 Lite is Google's lightweight variant of Nano Banana 2, designed for faster, lower-cost image generation and editing.
models.notes: the cheap tier of nano-banana 2

models.name: gpt-image-2
models.description: GPT Image 2 is OpenAI's image-generation and editing model, designed to follow detailed instructions and render text within images. These outputs use text-only prompts.

models.name: lucid-origin
models.description: Lucid Origin is Leonardo.Ai's image-generation model, designed for artistic imagery and a range of visual styles, with an emphasis on following text prompts.

models.name: nano-banana-2
models.description: Nano Banana 2 is Google's speed-focused image-generation model, supporting conversational edits and the combination of reference images. Here it works from text alone.

models.name: nano-banana-pro
models.description: Nano Banana Pro is Google's quality-focused image-generation and editing model. It belongs to the same family as the faster Nano Banana variants in the archive.

models.name: grok-imagine-image-2
models.description: Grok Imagine Image 2 is xAI's second-generation image model, supporting text-to-image generation and editing. It follows the earlier Grok Imagine listings in the archive.

models.name: p-image-lora
models.description: P-Image LoRA is Pruna AI's image model with support for small fine-tuned adapters, allowing the base model to specialise in particular subjects or styles.

models.name: p-image
models.description: P-Image is Pruna AI's text-to-image model designed for very short generation times. It provides a speed-focused comparison with larger image models in the archive.

models.name: z-image-turbo
models.description: Z-Image Turbo is Tongyi-MAI's speed-focused text-to-image model with six billion parameters. This listing serves it through Pruna AI's optimised implementation.

models.name: qwen-image-3
models.description: Qwen-Image 3 is Alibaba's image-generation and editing model, developed for text rendering and complex layouts. Pro provides a related variant for more demanding imagery.

models.name: qwen-image-3-pro
models.description: Qwen-Image 3 Pro is Alibaba's image-generation and editing model with an emphasis on dense text and multi-element layouts, complementing the standard Qwen-Image 3 listing.

models.name: seedream-5-pro
models.description: Seedream 5 Pro is ByteDance's flagship image-generation and editing model in the Seedream 5 family. The archive compares its text-only outputs with the Lite variant.

models.name: gpt-image-2.5-flare
models.description: GPT Image 2.5 Flare is the speed-focused model in OpenAI's GPT Image 2.5 family, supporting image generation and editing through written instructions.

models.name: gpt-image-2.5-sunburst
models.description: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst is OpenAI's precision-focused image-generation and editing model, complementing the faster Flare variant with an emphasis on detailed control.

models.name: p-image-ideogram
models.description: P-Image-Ideogram is Pruna AI's low-cost text-to-image model. Its crungus outputs appear alongside the other P-Image and Ideogram listings for comparison.

models.name: ideogram-4-5
models.description: Ideogram 4.5 is Ideogram's image-generation and editing model, accepting written instructions for new images or changes to existing ones. These outputs use text alone.

models.name: flux-3-image
models.description: FLUX 3 is Black Forest Labs' image-generation and editing model. This archive uses its text-to-image capability to interpret the crungus prompts.

models.name: imagen-3
models.description: Imagen 3 is Google's third-generation Imagen text-to-image model, designed for detailed imagery and natural lighting. A separate Fast variant prioritises generation speed.

models.name: imagen-3-fast
models.description: Imagen 3 Fast is Google's accelerated variant of Imagen 3, designed to reduce generation time and cost at some expense to image quality.

models.name: imagen-4
models.description: Imagen 4 is Google's fourth-generation Imagen text-to-image model. The archive also includes its Fast and Ultra variants, designed for different speed and quality priorities.

models.name: imagen-4-fast
models.description: Imagen 4 Fast is Google's speed-focused variant of Imagen 4. It trades some image quality for faster, cheaper generation within the same family.

models.name: imagen-4-ultra
models.description: Imagen 4 Ultra is Google's quality-focused variant of Imagen 4, designed to favour image detail over the speed of the standard and Fast versions.

models.name: nano-banana-2.1
models.description: Nano Banana 2.1 is a revision of Google's fast image-generation and editing model, developed with an emphasis on text rendering and higher-resolution output.
